title: drynaria brancifolia
intro: Drynaria brancifolia, commonly known as Chinese lizard's tail or polypodium leucotomos, is a type of plant in the Polypodiaceae family, specifically a species of fern. It is used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Drynaria brancifolia include enhancing immune function, reducing oxidative stress, and inhibiting cancer cell growth. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
